description: Source code for a Linux kernel module implementing a trivial Ethernet relay, including functions for handling network frames, managing relay devices, and integrating with debugfs and netdevice notifier subsystems.

methods.name: trelay_handle_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming Ethernet frames, forwarding them to the appropriate device if conditions are met.

methods.name: trelay_open
methods.description: Opens the relay device file, setting private data.

methods.name: trelay_do_remove
methods.description: Removes a relay device, cleaning up resources and unregistering handlers.

methods.name: trelay_find
methods.description: Finds a relay device associated with a given network device.

methods.name: tr_device_event
methods.description: Handles network device events, specifically unregistration, to remove associated relays.

methods.name: trelay_remove_write
methods.description: Marks a relay for removal when written to.

methods.name: trelay_remove_release
methods.description: Removes relay devices marked for removal during file release.

methods.name: trelay_do_add
methods.description: Creates and registers a new relay between two network devices.

methods.name: trelay_add_write
methods.description: Parses user input to add a new relay device.

methods.name: trelay_init
methods.description: Initializes the Ethernet relay module, setting up debugfs entries and notifier.

methods.name: trelay_exit
methods.description: Cleans up the Ethernet relay module, unregistering notifier and removing relay devices.
